hints.title: Factor Testing
hints.text: An integer i divides n evenly when n modulo i equals 0.

hints.title: Ascending Check
hints.text: Iterate i from 1 to n. Whenever i divides n, decrement k.

hints.title: Termination
hints.text: If k reaches 0, return i immediately. If loop finishes without finding k factors, return -1.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Looping up to n takes at most 1000 steps, which executes well under 1 millisecond.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Constant auxiliary space and linear iteration in n.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate writes a clean early-exit divisibility loop.
complexity.notes: Can also be optimized to O(sqrt(N)) by checking factors in complementary pairs.
